author: Unity
description:
Learn how the Unity CLI and Unity Pipeline APIs transform your development workflow—from rapid AI-driven prototyping to full-team production.

With Unity CLI 1.0 officially out of beta, you can avoid throwaway prototypes by keeping your work inside a real Unity project from day one. Using official Unity plugins for agents like Claude Code and Codex, your AI agent can operate directly from the terminal to block out environments, write and compile code, catch errors, and playtest mechanics. Custom commands defined with the [CliCommand] attribute ensure agents follow your team's exact project conventions.

As prototypes scale into full production, Unity Pipeline APIs connect producers, artists, and QA testers through the browser directly to your team’s Git repository—no Editor install required. description:
The Unity Preset Manager lets you define and automate importer, component, and scriptable GameObject settings for project assets. This quick tip shows you how to apply settings for pixel art textures, such as Point filter mode and no compression, while maintaining different settings for non-pixel art  textures.
